content:
morgan: deploy-bot flagged promote blocked for web-ui -> staging. build step failing during npm install from private registry with 401. release window in 25m, need quick unblock.

deploy-bot: [system] Promotion blocked: build failed during dependency fetch. Logs:
```
npm ERR! code E401
npm ERR! 401 Unauthorized - GET https://npm.private.company/@redwood/ui/-/ui-1.2.3.tgz - Token expired
```

devops-bot: automated note: registry token rotated 5m ago for security. New token propagated to most runners, but some self-hosted runners still have old creds.

hari (infra): looks like the self-hosted runner pool in us-west-2 didn't pick up the env rotation. Quick options: 1) pin to last-green build artifact (web-ui:2026-03-15-rc2), 2) rerun build on a runner with fresh token, or 3) temporarily set npm auth to read-only mirror (not ideal). Pin is fastest.

nina (qa): pin ok with me for the window. If we rerun we might miss canary. We must call it out in release notes.

ben (release-manager): i'm +1 for pin to rc2 and hold canary. Do the pin, mark in notes, and open follow-up to fix runner token propagation.

morgan: @hari can you try the quick rerun on control-plane runners while we decide? command I usually use:
```
ci-runner trigger --image ubuntu-22.04 --env-file /etc/ci/envs/latest --job build-web-ui
```

hari: kicked a rerun on control-plane runners now. If that passes we can promote without pin, but if it times out we'll pin.

deploy-bot: rerun finished: build on control-plane runners PASSED, artifact web-ui:2026-03-22-rc5 created. However deploy to staging blocked because deploy pool includes us-west-2 self-hosted nodes which still lack token. Promote blocked: deploy-agent failed to fetch artifact on one canary node.

ben: decision: pin to web-ui:2026-03-15-rc2 for this release window to avoid mixing environments. I'll execute promote --pin and hold canary. We'll follow up to rotate runner tokens and re-run a clean promotion tomorrow.

morgan: ben executed promote --pin web-ui:2026-03-15-rc2 at 1732468250. Canary: held (1/3). ben please add release note: 'pinned web-ui to 2026-03-15-rc2 due to registry token rotation causing self-hosted runner auth failures; control-plane rerun produced rc5 but some self-hosted runners still need token propagation; will re-promote after runner fix.'

ben: added to release notes and created follow-up ticket: https://tracker.company/RED-6011 "Runner token propagation fixes + re-promote web-ui rc5".

morgan: hari please prioritize the token propagation fix. closing this thread for the release window. :white_check_mark:
